decision: The study layer reads the snapshot through tools/study/examiner_source.py. The ledger is not regenerated: it is the recovery ledger build_examiner_index resolves FROM; regenerating it from the generated index would be circular.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.meaning: one or more primary tracker records name this examiner and this question

reported.label: Reported
reported.meaning: an external surveyor compilation reports this examiner asking this question; not tracker-confirmed

ce_tip.label: CE Tip
ce_tip.meaning: the QB card itself declares the attribution; not tracker-confirmed

header.label: Header
header.meaning: attribution from the QB page header only

inferred.label: Inferred
inferred.meaning: topic inference; no primary record and no page assertion
